fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: British citizens need a visa to visit Australia.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos británicos necesitan un visado para visitar Australia.
entry.quote: You must have a visa to visit Australia.

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.
entry.es: Su pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda la duración de su estancia prevista.
entry.quote: your passport must be valid for the length of your planned stay.

entry.en: British citizens can usually get an eVisitor visa, which has no application charge or service fee.
entry.es: Los ciudadanos británicos suelen poder obtener el visado eVisitor, sin tasa de solicitud ni cargo por servicio.
entry.quote: eVisitor visa – there is no visa application charge or service fee

entry.en: You must fill in an Incoming Passenger Card and declare risk goods such as food, animal products and plant material.
entry.es: Debe rellenar una tarjeta de pasajero entrante y declarar artículos de riesgo como alimentos, productos animales y material vegetal.
entry.quote: You must fill in an Incoming Passenger Card and either:

entry.en: Breaking quarantine rules can bring a heavy fine.
entry.es: Infringir las normas de cuarentena puede suponer una multa elevada.
entry.quote: You can get a heavy fine if you break quarantine.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si viene de un país catalogado como de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Australia.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Australia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Australia.

safety.en: Rip currents are the main hazard for swimmers and surfers and can happen at any beach.
safety.es: Las corrientes de resaca son el principal peligro para nadadores y surfistas y pueden darse en cualquier playa.
safety.quote: Rip currents are the main hazard for all swimmers and surfers. They can happen at any beach

safety.en: Australia has many dangerous animal species, including crocodiles, jellyfish, sharks, venomous insects, spiders and snakes in many parts of the country.
safety.es: Australia tiene muchas especies animales peligrosas, como cocodrilos, medusas, tiburones, insectos venenosos, arañas y serpientes en muchas zonas.
safety.quote: There are crocodiles, jellyfish, sharks, venomous insects, spiders and snakes in many parts of the country.

safety.en: In the bush or national parks it can take hours to get help in an emergency.
safety.es: En el monte o los parques nacionales puede tardar horas en llegar ayuda en una emergencia.
safety.quote: It can take hours to get help in an emergency in the bush or national parks.

safety.en: There are many types of scams targeting people in or travelling to Australia, including dating and romance scams and fake service websites.
safety.es: Hay muchos tipos de estafas dirigidas a quienes viajan a Australia, incluidas estafas románticas y sitios web de servicios falsos.
safety.quote: There are many different types of scams targeting people in or travelling to Australia, including dating and romance scams, websites offering fake services

safety.en: Wikivoyage says tourists are far more likely to be killed or injured on Australian roads than from all other causes combined.
safety.es: Wikivoyage indica que los turistas tienen mucha más probabilidad de morir o resultar heridos en las carreteras australianas que por todas las demás causas juntas.
safety.quote: Tourists are far more likely to be killed or injured as pedestrians, drivers or passengers on Australian roads than all the other causes of death and injury combined.

health.en: UK visitors can access essential and urgent medical care under the UK-Australia Reciprocal Healthcare Agreement.
health.es: Los visitantes del Reino Unido pueden acceder a atención médica esencial y urgente según el acuerdo recíproco de salud entre ambos países.
health.quote: you can access essential and urgent medical care through the UK-Australia Reciprocal Healthcare Agreement.

health.en: Essential and urgent hospital treatment is free, but there is a charge for GP visits and prescriptions.
health.es: El tratamiento hospitalario esencial y urgente es gratuito, pero se paga por las consultas de médico de cabecera y las recetas.
health.quote: Essential and urgent hospital treatment is free. There is a charge to visit GPs and receive prescriptions.

health.en: Ambulance services and medical evacuations are excluded from the reciprocal agreement and are very expensive.
health.es: Las ambulancias y evacuaciones médicas están excluidas del acuerdo recíproco y son muy caras.
health.quote: use of ambulance services and medical evacuations, which are very expensive.

health.en: Health risks include dengue and Japanese encephalitis and other insect or tick-borne diseases.
health.es: Los riesgos sanitarios incluyen el dengue y la encefalitis japonesa y otras enfermedades transmitidas por insectos o garrapatas.
health.quote:
dengue

- Japanese encephalitis and other insect or tick-borne diseases

health.en: Wikivoyage says tap water in urban Australia is always safe to drink.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que el agua del grifo en las zonas urbanas de Australia siempre es segura para beber.
health.quote: The tap water in urban Australia is always safe to drink.

health.en: Wikivoyage says it can take as little as 15 minutes to burn on a fine summer's day.
health.es: Wikivoyage indica que en un día despejado de verano uno puede quemarse en tan solo 15 minutos.
health.quote: It can take as little as 15 minutes to burn in Australia on a fine summer's day

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 000.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 000.

help.en: Wikivoyage says 000 can be dialled free from any telephone in Australia.
help.es: Wikivoyage indica que el 000 se puede marcar gratis desde cualquier teléfono en Australia.
help.quote: The number 000 (called 'triple zero' or 'triple oh') can be dialled from any telephone in Australia free of charge.

help.en: Urgent help for a friend or relative abroad is available from FCDO in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours.
help.es: Para ayuda urgente por un amigo o familiar en el extranjero, el FCDO en Londres atiende en el 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

help.en: Wikivoyage says the State Emergency Service on 132 500 can help during floods, storms, cyclones and similar disasters.
help.es: Wikivoyage indica que el Servicio de Emergencias Estatal (132 500) ayuda en inundaciones, tormentas, ciclones y desastres similares.
help.quote: you can contact the State Emergency Service in each state (except for Northern Territory) on 132 500.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says everybody except New Zealanders needs a visa in advance of travel.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que todos, salvo los neozelandeses, necesitan un visado antes de viajar.
getting_in.quote: Everybody (except New Zealanders)  requires a visa in advance of travel.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says the eVisitor (subclass 651) is free and is for citizens of the EU, Norway, Iceland, Switzerland and the United Kingdom, among others.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que el eVisitor (subclase 651) es gratuito y es para ciudadanos de la UE, Noruega, Islandia, Suiza y el Reino Unido, entre otros.
getting_in.quote: eVisitor (subclass 651) is for citizens of the European Union, Norway, Iceland, Switzerland, the United Kingdom and a few European microstates.

getting_in.en: Wikivoyage says tourist visa applicants must show they can support themselves financially and meet character requirements.
getting_in.es: Wikivoyage indica que los solicitantes de visado turístico deben demostrar que pueden mantenerse económicamente y cumplir los requisitos de carácter.
getting_in.quote: you must be able to demonstrate your ability to support yourself financially for the time you intend to spend in Australia and meet character requirements.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says public transport is fairly reliable in Sydney, Melbourne, Perth and south-east Queensland, but a car is preferable elsewhere.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que el transporte público es bastante fiable en Sídney, Melbourne, Perth y el sudeste de Queensland, pero fuera de ellas es preferible un coche.
getting_around.quote: While public transportation is fairly reliable in Sydney, Melbourne, Perth, and SE Queensland, having a car is preferable, or in some cases essential, to get around anywhere else.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says Australia drives on the left.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que en Australia se conduce por la izquierda.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says overseas licences are generally valid for three months after arrival, and an International Driving Permit is needed if the licence is not in English.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que los carnés extranjeros suelen valer tres meses desde la llegada y que hace falta un permiso internacional si no están en inglés.
getting_around.quote: Generally, overseas licenses are valid for driving in Australia for three months after arrival. If the licence is not in English, an International Driving Permit (IDP) is required in addition to your licence.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says the default speed limit is 50 km/h in built-up areas and 100 km/h on rural roads in most of Australia.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que el límite de velocidad habitual es de 50 km/h en zonas urbanas y 100 km/h en carreteras rurales en la mayor parte de Australia.
getting_around.quote: The default speed limit in most of Australia is 50 km/h in built-up areas, and 100 km/h on rural roads, unless signed otherwise

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says wildlife and large trucks are the major road hazards, with extra risk of animal collisions at dusk or in the dark.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que la fauna y los camiones grandes son los principales peligros viales, con más riesgo de colisión con animales al anochecer o de noche.
getting_around.quote: Major hazards on Australian roads are wildlife and large trucks. Be sure to take extra care when driving at dusk or in the dark, as the risk of animal collisions increases significantly.

getting_around.en: Wikivoyage says driving from Sydney to Perth (4000 km) takes about half a week, so most visitors are better off flying.
getting_around.es: Wikivoyage indica que conducir de Sídney a Perth (4000 km) lleva media semana, por lo que a la mayoría de visitantes les conviene volar.
getting_around.quote: Drives like Sydney to Perth (4000 km) or Adelaide to Darwin (3000 km) require spending half a week in your car, and most visitors are much better off flying.

money.en: Wikivoyage says Australia is largely a cashless society, as virtually all businesses accept credit and debit cards.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que Australia es una sociedad en gran medida sin efectivo, ya que prácticamente todos los comercios aceptan tarjetas.
money.quote: Australia is largely a cashless society, as virtually all businesses accept credit cards and debit cards.

money.en: Wikivoyage says the currency is the Australian dollar (AUD), divided into 100 cents.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que la moneda es el dólar australiano (AUD), dividido en 100 centavos.
money.quote: The Australian currency is known as the dollar, denoted by the symbol "$" or "A$" (ISO code: AUD). It is divided into 100 cents (c).

money.en: Wikivoyage says card surcharges of 1-2% at cafes, pubs and restaurants are common and legal.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que los recargos del 1-2% por pagar con tarjeta en cafés, bares y restaurantes son habituales y legales.
money.quote: 1-2% surcharges for card payments at cafes, pubs and restaurants are common (and perfectly legal)

money.en: Wikivoyage says airport exchange outlets usually give terrible rates, around 10% from the exchange midpoint.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que las casas de cambio del aeropuerto suelen dar tipos pésimos, en torno a un 10% del punto medio.
money.quote: These exchange outlets — especially the ones at the airport — usually give terrible rates, usually around 10% from current exchange midpoint.

money.en: Wikivoyage says cash payments are rounded to the nearest five cents, while card payments are charged exactly.
money.es: Wikivoyage indica que los pagos en efectivo se redondean a los cinco centavos más cercanos y los pagos con tarjeta se cobran exactos.
money.quote: If the total of a transaction is not a multiple of 5 cents the amount will be rounded to the nearest five cents if you are paying in cash. The exact amount will be charged if paying by card.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says it is acceptable and normal to use first names in all situations.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que es aceptable y normal usar el nombre de pila en cualquier situación.
etiquette.quote: It is acceptable and normal to use first names in all situations, even to people many years your senior.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says it is normal to wear at least a shirt and footwear when leaving the beach area.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que es normal llevar al menos camiseta y calzado al alejarse de la playa.
etiquette.quote: It is normal to wear at least a shirt and footwear before venturing any further.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage advises covering up a little more when visiting places of worship.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage aconseja cubrirse algo más al visitar lugares de culto.
etiquette.quote: Cover up a little more when visiting places of worship such as churches.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says using stereotypical Australian expressions may be seen as mocking.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que usar expresiones típicas australianas puede interpretarse como una burla.
etiquette.quote: Using Australian stereotypical expressions may be viewed as an attempt to mock, rather than to communicate.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says service workers expect customers to treat them as equals.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que los trabajadores de servicios esperan que los clientes los traten como iguales.
etiquette.quote: Service workers, including hotel staff, waiters, cleaners, taxi drivers, and shop employees, expect that customers will treat them as equals.

etiquette.en: Wikivoyage says some Aboriginal land requires permission or a permit, and some areas are protected and illegal to enter.
etiquette.es: Wikivoyage indica que algunas tierras aborígenes requieren permiso y que algunas zonas protegidas tienen la entrada prohibida.
etiquette.quote: some Aboriginal land requires permission or a permit, and some areas are protected and illegal to enter.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says virtually all accommodation in Australia has free WiFi, as do most cafes, restaurants and shopping malls.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que prácticamente todos los alojamientos en Australia tienen WiFi gratis, igual que la mayoría de cafés, restaurantes y centros comerciales.
connectivity.quote: Virtually all accommodation in Australia has free WiFi, as do most cafes, restaurants and shopping malls

connectivity.en: The mobile network generally works well in cities and large towns, but coverage elsewhere can be very limited or non-existent.
connectivity.es: La red móvil funciona bien en general en ciudades y localidades grandes, pero fuera de ellas la cobertura puede ser muy limitada o inexistente.
connectivity.quote: The mobile phone network generally works well in cities and large towns, but coverage elsewhere can be very limited or non-existent.

connectivity.en: Many visitors prefer to buy an Australian SIM card on arrival, since UK roaming calls can be expensive.
connectivity.es: Muchos visitantes prefieren comprar una SIM australiana al llegar, ya que las llamadas en itinerancia desde el Reino Unido pueden ser caras.
connectivity.quote: Many visitors prefer to buy an Australian SIM card on arrival.

connectivity.en: Wikivoyage says people under 16 are prohibited from having accounts on major social media networks.
connectivity.es: Wikivoyage indica que se prohíbe a los menores de 16 años tener cuentas en las principales redes sociales.
connectivity.quote: The Australian government prohibits individuals under 16 from creating or maintaining accounts on major social media and streaming networks
